_note: Model/deployment registry for FoundryVisionProvider. NO SECRETS: the endpoint and key are common to the Foundry resource and come from .env (TCP_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT/TCP_FOUNDRY_API_KEY, or the existing ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY). 'api' is the API family verified for the deployment (anthropic_messages for Claude, openai_responses for GPT); Claude deployments must not use openai_responses (verified 2026-10-18: the image is dropped and the schema is not enforced there). TCP_FOUNDRY_PROFILE selects a profile; default_profile otherwise (gpt-5.6-sol: the agent's call-2 schema exceeds the Claude strict-grammar limit, verified live 2026-10-19).

claude-opus-5-5-fast.description: Separate Foundry deployment of the same model (responses report claude-opus-5-5)
